About the role

Our freight network group in Denver is looking for a commercial project manager to own the financial controlling and reporting of terminal build-out projects. You will work alongside the technical project managers to deliver each project against its contract, forecast cost and margin every month, and flag variances early.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain project budgets, forecasts and cash-flow plans.
  • Review change orders and claims with the project team.
  • Prepare monthly project reviews for the regional finance lead.
  • Keep invoicing and milestone billing on schedule.

What you bring

  • A degree in finance, accounting or a related field.
  • Several years of project controlling experience on construction or logistics projects.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and clear written communication.
